note: Adapted from Hill's (1942) species-level description, the original in English; the original uses Eutermes hastilis. The original notes that a series of cotypes contains soldiers and workers of E. longipennis, and that Froggatt's original soldier description combines characters of both species; this is reproduced here in the note for verification and is not included in the morphology sections. Distribution, biology and affinities are not translated into the morphology sections. OCR misreadings: 'soldior'='soldier', 'lab rum'='labrum', 'P ro notum'='Pronotum', 'hcstilis'/'hestilis'/'he stills'='hastilis', 'Kimherleyensis'='kimberleyensis', 'Proggatt'='Froggatt'.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is medium-sized and very dark brown, the wing membrane hyaline or faintly tinged with brown, the head and pronotum densely covered with short hairs, the body length with wings 11.00—14.50 mm; it is smaller than E. tumuli, with paler wings and 1—2 more antennal segments, larger than E. apiocephalus, with paler wings and 1—2 more antennal segments, and larger than E. westraliensis in most measurements, with paler wings and usually 1 more antennal segment. The soldier is very close to E. kimberleyensis of Western Australia and may be a variety of it; its head is distinctly constricted at the anterior 1/3 and the nasus is very narrow.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Medium-sized, very dark brown, the wing membrane hyaline or faintly tinged with brown, the head and pronotum densely covered with short hairs. Head, thorax and abdominal tergites dark brown, the legs, antennae and underside paler, the postclypeus yellow-brown to dark brown, usually distinctly paler than the head. Head broadly oval. Compound eyes medium-sized and protruding. Ocelli broadly oval, about their long diameter from the compound eyes. Fontanelle smaller than the ocelli, forked anteriorly. Postclypeus length more than half its width. Mandibular teeth 1 and 2 about equal in length. Antennae 16- or 17-segmented, usually 17 (a few specimens from Northam, Western Australia, with 15 or 16); segment 3 very short and narrow, rarely longer than segment 2; segments 4 and 6 about equal in length; segment 5 smaller than segments 4 and 6. Pronotum only slightly narrower than the head, the anterior and posterior margins slightly wavy, the sides distinctly narrowed. Posterior margin of mesonotum and metanotum wide and rather deeply emarginate, sometimes with a small projection at the apex of the emargination. Wings varying greatly in size, the costa and radial sector very dark; media distinct only at the extreme base; cubitus with only 3 or 4 basal branches distinct. Measurements: body length with wings 11.00—14.50 mm; body length without wings 6.75—8.60 mm; head length (to apex of labrum) 1.39—1.65 mm; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.80—0.88 mm; head width 1.19—1.35 mm; maximum diameter of compound eye 0.33—0.40 mm; ocellus length 0.11—0.15 mm; pronotum length 0.62—0.69 mm; pronotum width 1.00—1.17 mm; forewing length 8.50—12.00 mm; forewing width 2.71—3.22 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head varying greatly in size, orange to pale ferruginous, the base and the apical 1/3 of the head capsule palest, the nasus pale to dark ferruginous, the thorax, legs and abdominal tergites pale yellow-brown. Head and abdomen with sparse, fine hairs. Head in dorsal view wide, broadly rounded, or with the posterior margin almost truncate, distinctly constricted at the anterior 1/3; nasus very variable, usually about 3/5 of the rest of the head, very narrow, sometimes distinctly longer and wider at the base (notably in series from Northam and Walebang). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 usually the shortest of all; segment 4 long, longer than segment 5; sometimes segments 2, 3 and 5 equal in length and shorter than segment 4; or segment 2 the shortest of all, only slightly shorter than segment 4. Mandibles usually without apical teeth. Measurements: body length 3.50—4.50 mm; head length (to apex of nasus) 1.46—1.65 mm; head width 0.84—0.91 mm; pronotum width 0.44—0.55 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head above mostly orange-yellow, widest anteriorly, narrowing towards the wide posterior margin. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 2 usually shorter than segment 3; segment 4 distinctly longer than segments 3 and 5. Postclypeus length more than half its width. Measurements: body length 4.75—5.20 mm; head length (to apex of labrum) 1.64—1.79 mm; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.80—1.10 mm; head width 1.32—1.39 mm; pronotum width 0.75—0.82 mm.
